data.name: Hamidi
data.gender_notes: Hamidi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is a friend, a companion, and one who is trustworthy and reliable. The name Hamidi carries the meaning “Companion, friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Hamidi usually hope their child will grow to embody companion, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies being a friend and companion to Allah, and being trustworthy and reliable in one's faith
data.etymology: Hamidi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion, friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamidi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حميدي
in_arabic.meaning: منسوب إلى حميد، الشخص المحمود والمحترم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حميدي مشتق من اسم حميد، وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الشخص الذي يوصف بالمحمودية والاحترام. وقد وردت هذه الأسماء في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌ حَمِيدٌ' (آل عمران: 118)، وتعني هذه الآية أن الله تعالى عليم بكل شيء، ومحمود في جميع أفعاله وأقواله.

in_urdu.name: حمیدی
in_urdu.meaning: حمید سے مشتق، قابل ستائش اور محترم شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمیدی نام حمید سے ماخوذ ہے، جو ا اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔ یہ نام قابل ستائش اور محترم شخص کے معنی میں ہے۔ عربی زبان میں 'حميد' کی اصطلاح محمود اور قابل ستائش کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتی ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں ہے: 'وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌ حَمِيدٌ' (آل عمران: 118)۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हमیدی
in_hindi.meaning: हमीद से संबंधित, प्रशंसनीय और सम्मानित व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: हमیدی नाम हमीद से लिया गया है, जो ईश्वर के सुंदर नामों में से एक है। यह नाम प्रशंसनीय और सम्मानित व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है। अरबी भाषा में 'हमीद' की शब्दावली प्रशंसनीय और सम्मान के अर्थ में प्रयोग होती है, जैसा कि कुरआन में है: 'वहु अल्लिमुन हमीदुन' (आल-इमरान: 118)। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है।

in_pashto.name: حميدي
in_pashto.meaning: د حمید څخه مشتق، ستایلی او درناوی شخص
in_pashto.long_meaning: حميدي نوم د حميد څخه اخستل شوی دی، کوم چې د الله ښو نومونو څخه يو دی. دا نوم د ستایلی او درناوي شخص معنی لري. په عربي ژبه کې 'حميد' د ستاينې او درناوي په معني استعماليږي، لکه څنګه چې په قران کريم کې دی: 'وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌ حَمِيدٌ' (آل عمران: 118). دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو او نورو مسلمانانو تر منځ ډیر مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Hamidi
in_english.meaning: Derived from Hamid, meaning praised and respected person
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hamidi is derived from the Arabic name Hamid, which is one of the beautiful names of Allah. It means a person who is praised and respected. The term 'Hamid' in Arabic is used to describe someone or something that is praiseworthy and respectable, as mentioned in the Quran: 'He is All-Knowing and Praiseworthy' (Al-Imran: 118). The name Hamidi holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing positive attributes such as gratitude and acknowledgment of divine praise.

pronunciation.urdu: حمیدی کا تلفظ: ہا می دی
pronunciation.hindi: हमیدی का उच्चारण: हा मी दी
pronunciation.pashto: د حميدي تلفظ: ها می دی

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hamidi" represents a historical and cultural significance in the Islamic world. Throughout Islamic history, the term "Hamid" or "Hamidi" has been used to honor individuals who showcased great loyalty, commitment, and support towards the Muslim community. The name reflects the values of companionship, trustworthiness, and reliability that are deeply rooted in Islamic traditions and teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Hamidi" carries a profound meaning that reflects the virtues of compassion, generosity, and kindness. According to Islamic teachings, being a true friend and companion of others is one of the most excellent ways to please Allah and gain His favor. The spiritual significance of the name Hamidi lies in its reminder to live up to the high ethical standards set by the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and strive to be a good companion, a reliable friend, and a source of comfort and support to those around us. This name provides a daily reminder to cultivate our inner selves and work towards building strong relationships based on mutual respect, love, and trust. Ultimately, it invites us to embody the best of human qualities and contribute to making this world a better place for all.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Companion, friend" symbolizes One who is a friend, a companion, and one who is trustworthy and reliable. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hamidi serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of companion, friend.
